strings.text: Speak to the Elder.  He has something important to tell you first.
Follow me.  I know the way to the lair.
Boy, I wish you had the guts to help us out.
All ready to go? Once we get to the lair, there is no coming back until the job is done.
OK, I'll wait for here. Let me know when you're ready to go.
